problems.description: Attackers send emails impersonating trusted entities to trick users into entering their login credentials on fake websites, leading to account compromise.
risk_reduction: Implement multi-factor authentication (MFA) across all user accounts
Deploy advanced email filtering and anti-phishing tools
Conduct regular user awareness training and simulated phishing exercises

problems.description: Targeted phishing attacks aimed at specific individuals or roles within an organization, often using personalized information to increase credibility and success rate.
risk_reduction: Educate employees on recognizing spear phishing tactics
Use email authentication protocols like DMARC, DKIM, and SPF
Limit the amount of personal information publicly available about employees

problems.description: Cybercriminals compromise or spoof business email accounts to request fraudulent wire transfers or sensitive data from employees or partners.
risk_reduction: Verify financial requests through secondary communication channels
Implement strict email authentication and monitoring
Train staff to recognize and report suspicious email activity

problems.description: Use of AI to craft highly convincing phishing messages at scale, increasing success rates and evading detection.
risk_reduction: Deploy AI-aware email filtering solutions
Enhance user training with examples of AI-generated content
Monitor for anomalous communication patterns

problems.description: Publicly exposed cloud storage buckets (e.g., AWS S3, Azure Blob) leading to data leakage or unauthorized access.
risk_reduction: Implement strict access controls and bucket policies
Regularly audit cloud storage configurations
Use automated tools to detect misconfigurations

problems.description: Attackers compromise software vendors or update mechanisms to distribute malicious code to downstream customers.
risk_reduction: Implement software supply chain risk management
Use code signing and verify software integrity
Monitor vendor security posture and alerts

problems.description: Attackers inject malicious data into training sets to corrupt machine learning models, causing misclassification or backdoors.
risk_reduction: Validate and sanitize training data
Implement robust ML model monitoring
Use adversarial training techniques

problems.description: Professional ransomware groups offering ransomware tools and infrastructure to affiliates, increasing attack frequency and sophistication.
risk_reduction: Maintain offline backups and test recovery
Implement endpoint detection and response (EDR)
Conduct threat hunting and network segmentation
